# Evryday Archive Co

> Evryday Archive Co (also known as Everyday Archive Co) is a photography business run by Reed McIlwain, a BC photographer based in Kamloops. Reed regularly shoots in Vancouver, Victoria, and across Vancouver Island. He documents ordinary life as something worth keeping — lifestyle, family, couples, and everyday moments. Sessions are designed to be low-pressure, accessible, and transparently priced with no hidden fees. Passion Projects, a recurring photo and story series about people doing what they love, is a core part of the brand.

## About

Photographer: Reed McIlwain
Business name: Evryday Archive Co
Alternate name: Everyday Archive Co
Location: Kamloops, British Columbia, Canada
Regularly shoots in: Vancouver, Victoria, Vancouver Island, and across British Columbia
Style: Candid, documentary, lifestyle — natural light, real moments
Pricing philosophy: Transparent and adjustable. No surprise fees. Packages are publicly listed.

## Passion Projects

Passion Projects is Evryday Archive Co's recurring series of photo stories about people putting years into a craft, a project, a hobby, or a business they love. It runs in seasons and returns each round, and it is a lasting part of the brand rather than a one-off promotion. The current round is Winter 2026, and features are numbered within each season (for example, "Winter 2026, Feature 01").

The idea, in Reed's words: "Somewhere close by, someone is putting years into a craft, a project, or a business they love. They deserve to have their story told, in photographs and in their own words, even if they're too busy doing the thing to ask." The page asks visitors: "Who would you put in the spotlight?"

The page opens with a wall of photos Reed has taken over the past year as Evryday Archive Co: people doing things they love, from baking and brewing to rally driving, pool, and running a corn dog cart. Passion Projects is how he's looking for more of that work.

How it works:

1. Apply with a session. Pick a package the usual way and tick the box to be featured.
2. A short call. Reed replies within 24 to 48 hours, usually to set up a quick call.
3. The session. Photos of the person doing their thing, with a conversation while they shoot. The conversation is recorded as audio only, never video.
4. The story. It's shared on the website and on Instagram, only after the person has read it and signed off.

Features are chosen for variety, and everyone who applies gets photographed either way.

People can also nominate someone they know. If the person they send Reed's way books a session, the referrer gets $15 off a session of their own, whether or not that person is featured.

Sessions take place in and around Kamloops, Victoria, and Vancouver.

[Book a Session](https://www.evrydayarchive.co/book): Formal session request form. Collects name, contact details, preferred date, and package selection. Date is non-binding pending confirmation.

[About](https://www.evrydayarchive.co/about): Background on Reed McIlwain — the photographer, their approach, and the philosophy behind Evryday Archive Co.

[FAQ](https://www.evrydayarchive.co/faq): Answers to common questions about booking, pricing, turnaround time, what to wear, and what to expect from a session.
